visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a gray t-shirt, sits on a gray fabric sofa. She faces the camera directly, gesturing with her hands while speaking. In front of her are two open laptops. Behind her sits a small stuffed sea otter and an orange pillow against a white wall. (2) The scene transitions to a screen recording of a laptop. A hand is seen briefly typing as the browser navigates the Google search page and then the Chrome Web Store. The mouse cursor moves across the interface, clicking on search results and extension buttons. (3) The recording displays the 'Shorts to Normal player' extension page. The cursor clicks 'Add to Chrome,' and a system confirmation dialog box appears on screen. (4) The woman is back in frame, pointing at the screens of the two laptops. The laptop on the right shows a YouTube Shorts video playing in a standard horizontal video player interface with a progress bar and volume controls. (5) The camera provides a close-up of the browser menu as a mouse clicks through extension settings to show how to remove the tool. The woman concludes by smiling and giving a thumbs-up gesture between the two devices.
